ai_productivity.source: Published AI productivity studies 2023-2026 (see comment); low-confidence rows are reasoned defaults

calibration.source: should-cost: no factor fitted to market prices. Effort per block from published effort data (catalog v5); the spread between teams from ISBSG (Java h/FP P10-P90 4.8-29.4, P25-P75 5.9-15.6) and Anda, Sjoberg & Mockus 2009 (35 firms, one specification).
calibration.notes: Should-cost: what the work should cost from its hours (checked against 825 finished projects) and rates, not what vendors charged. Small apps were bought for about half of this (median 0.55x; Indian vendors and lowest-bid tenders price below a full-effort cost); medium and large contracts cost about 1.5x and 3x more, as they carry much more than the features they list (years of operations, staff on site, hardware, change requests).
